name: University of Massachusetts Amherst
tests: Holistic review; English proficiency test requirements apply to international applicants (see UMass's English Proficiency Test Requirements page). SAT/ACT policy and minimum English scores could not be verified automatically.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Göttingen
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: Vanderbilt University
tests: SAT/ACT optional for fall 2027 and 2028 entry (required again from fall 2029). Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35, SAT EBRW 730-760, SAT Math 770-790. English test for non-native speakers (see Vanderbilt testing policies).
gpa_note: Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35; SAT EBRW 730-760; SAT Math 770-790.

name: University of Virginia
tests: International applicants must demonstrate English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or equivalent). Current SAT/ACT policy and score ranges could not be verified automatically; check admission.virginia.edu.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Cologne
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: Dartmouth College
tests: Standardized testing is required, but can be met in one of five ways: SAT or ACT (superscored), three AP exams, IB Diploma predicted/final results, or other routes listed on the testing-policy page. English proficiency evidence is reviewed for non-native speakers.

name: Taylor's University
tests: Entry based on school results per programme; international students need English proof (see programme pages).

name: Charles University
tests: No SAT/ACT. Most programmes use faculty entrance exams (some online), and foreign secondary diplomas need recognition (nostrification). English-taught programmes require proof of English; Czech-taught programmes require Czech. Medicine has its own entrance tests.
gpa_note: Admission mainly through faculty entrance exam results; some programmes also weigh school grades.

name: University of Sussex
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS Academic 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each component.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics BSc: ABB–BBB, or IB 32.

name: University of Antwerp
tests: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Dutch (B2 Dutch needed); the Bachelor of Social-Economic Sciences is taught in English and requires proof of English. Medicine and dentistry require the Flemish entrance exam.
gpa_note: Open admission with a recognised secondary diploma plus language proof; medicine is selective via entrance exam.

name: University of Pittsburgh
tests: Pitt is test optional for most programmes (some guaranteed-admission programmes may differ). International applicants must show English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo). Minimum scores could not be verified automatically.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Radboud University
tests: No SAT/ACT. English (bachelor's): IELTS Academic 6.0 with all sub-scores 6.0 (IELTS Online not accepted; One Skill Retake accepted); TOEFL iBT 80 with all sub-scores 20 (or 4.5 on the new scale; Home Edition not accepted); Cambridge C1 Advanced 169.
gpa_note: Diploma comparable to Dutch VWO with subject requirements; numerus fixus programmes rank applicants.

name: AFG College with the University of Aberdeen
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS or equivalent per programme.

name: Georgetown University
tests: SAT or ACT required. TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo strongly recommended for non-native speakers (no fixed minimum; strong scores expected).

name: Barzan University College (Swinburne University of Technology)
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS or equivalent; foundation programme available.

name: University of Waikato
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency evidence required for non-native speakers (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent at the programme's level).
gpa_note: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance.

name: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB)
tests: No SAT/ACT. You need a secondary diploma that gives university access in your home country (plus any entrance exam certificate required there). Dutch-taught programmes require Dutch at B2 (e.g. CNaVT or ITNA); English-taught bachelor's (e.g. Social Sciences, Business and Economics) require English at B2 via an accepted test.
gpa_note: Open admission with a qualifying diploma and language proof.

name: Xi'an Jiaotong University
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Dalhousie University
tests: SAT/ACT not required; admission is based on high-school grades and country-specific requirements. English proficiency required for non-native speakers (IELTS, TOEFL, CAEL, Duolingo or equivalent; minimums are listed on Dalhousie's requirements page).
gpa_note: Minimum grade averages by programme (typically 70%+; higher for health and engineering).

name: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; selection by document review and interview, with strong maths and science expected. Courses are taught in English, so English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent) is required; minimums are set in UNIST's admission guideline.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: University of Notre Dame
tests: Test-optional for fall 2027 applicants; SAT/ACT will be required again from fall 2028 entry. English proficiency evidence for non-native speakers (see international applicants page).

name: Xiamen University

gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Middle East Technical University (METU)
tests: One qualifying exam/diploma required, e.g. SAT 1200+ (Math 700+ for engineering, architecture and science programmes), ACT 27+, IB Diploma 33+, A-levels ABB in relevant subjects, Abitur 2.3 or better, French Bac 14/20, TR-YÖS. English: TOEFL iBT or PTE Academic at registration, or METU’s English Proficiency Exam (otherwise a one-year prep year); IELTS taken after 24 Dec 2022 is not accepted.
gpa_note: Minimum one of: SAT 1200 (Math 700 for engineering/architecture/sciences), ACT 27, IB 33, A-levels ABB, Abitur 2.3, French Bac 14/20; scores valid two years.

name: Sultan Qaboos University
tests: No SAT/ACT needed; admission is based on school-leaving results. English: IELTS / TOEFL for English-taught programmes (foundation programme available).

name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Linköping University
tests: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.
gpa_note: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.

name: Kyung Hee University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may support an application). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4+); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Simon Fraser University
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for international applicants (see SFU's English requirements).
